conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Anjali Gupta. Mera credit card ka cash withdrawal limit kya hai?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Anjali ji, main aapke card details check karta hoon. Kya aap apna card number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Aapke card ka cash withdrawal limit ₹50,000 per day hai. Kya aap isme koi change chahti hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Nahi, bas jankari chahiye thi. Koi charge toh nahi hai na?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Cash withdrawal pe 2.5% fee lagta hai, minimum ₹300. Main aapko details mail kar deta hoon. Theek hai?
